fullDescription: A high-precision dark-mode wizard interface for technical configurations, featuring a vertical card system for complex choices. This design system is optimized for data-heavy applications, fintech platforms, or scientific tools that require granular control and clear hierarchy. It utilizes an industrial color palette of deep grays (#151517, #212121) paired with a high-visibility orange accent (#e37400). Key elements include ASCII-based visualization blocks for technical clarity, a persistent sidebar for multi-step navigation, and compact, metadata-rich typography using the Inter font family.
prompt:
## Resumo
A professional enterprise wizard UI designed for complex decision-making processes, utilizing a vertical stack of interactive cards with integrated technical visualizations and a multi-state navigation sidebar.

## Estilo Visual
Create a dark-themed UI using the Inter font family. Core colors: Background #151517, Surface #212121, Sidebar #1a1a1c, Accent Orange #e37400, Border #424242. Typography: Body text 14px #EEEEEE, Secondary text 10px #9E9E9E, Headings 16px #FFFFFF Bold. All interactive elements should have a border-radius of 8px. Use a 0.5px or 1px border weight. Animation: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for state transitions. Status colors: Success Green #16a34a, Info Blue (border: blue-800/40, bg: blue-950/20). Tabular-nums should be used for all numeric or monospaced data.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Wizard Container
Construct a centered dialog container max-width 840px, height 720px. Use bg #212121 with a 1px border #424242 and a shadow-2xl. Include a 2px top-edge progress bar with background #424242 and an active fill of #e37400.

### Sidebar Navigation
A 240px wide vertical sidebar with bg #1a1a1c. Navigation items are buttons with 12px padding, 12px gap between icon and text. Completed steps show a green circular icon (#16a34a) with a checkmark. The active step uses bg #424242/50 with an orange circle indicator.

### Content Header
Title section with 20px bottom margin. H3 heading at 16px #FFFFFF, subtext at 14px #9E9E9E. Below, include a 'Smart Default' callout: rounded-md, blue-tinted border/bg, 10px font size for technical metadata.

### Vertical Selection Cards
Stackable row-based cards. Layout: Flex row, gap 24px, padding 16px. Left: 16px custom radio button (border #616161, active fill #e37400). Center: Title (14px Bold) and Description (10px). Right: Fixed-width (256px) monospace block with bg #000000/40, 9px leading-tight text for ASCII diagrams.

### Footer Actions
Sticky footer with top border #424242, bg #212121, padding 12px 24px. Left side: Grouped buttons (Back, Cancel, Skip) with 8px gap, #424242 border, 10px bold text. Right side: Primary CTA button with bg #e37400, 10px white bold text, and subtle shadow.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### ASCII Visualization Block — A code-like snippet used to visualize abstract logic (like hierarchy or flow) within a selection card.
Create a 256px wide container with bg-black/40. Font-family: monospace, Size: 9px. Text-color: #9E9E9E. Padding: 12px. Border: 1px #424242. Content must be pre-formatted to preserve whitespace for structural diagrams.

### Status Badge — Small, high-contrast label used for 'Recommended' or 'New' flags.
Inline-block badge with 2px corner radius. Bg: green-900/25 (approx #064e3b40), Text: #4ade80. Font: 8px, Uppercase, Bold. Padding: 2px 6px. Vertical-align: middle.

## Notas Especiais
Must-dos: Ensure all mono-spaced blocks use 'tabular-nums' for alignment. Maintain exactly 24px gap in card rows to separate the radio, text, and diagram clearly. Must-nots: Do not use vibrant colors for non-interactive text; keep descriptions in the #757575 to #9E9E9E range to maintain hierarchy. Do not exceed 840px width for the wizard to ensure focus.

style.description: The style is characterized by a 'Technical Industrial' aesthetic. It uses a deep dark theme with a restricted color palette to minimize eye strain during complex tasks. Typography is highly hierarchical, leveraging font sizes from 8px to 16px to create clear information density. Borders are subtle (#424242) except when highlighting active states with a vibrant orange (#e37400). Micro-interactions focus on subtle background shifts (white/5% opacity) and smooth border transitions.
